title: Length of the Reduction Quantifier List
statement: For any natural number $n$, the list of quantifiers formed by concatenating three blocks of existential quantifiers, each of length $R$, with the quantifier list for $R$ levels and width $R$ has length $3R^2+3R$, where $R=A(c+1)(n+1)^a$ and $A,a,c$ are the parameters defined by the reduction construction.
caveat: The remaining parameters are fixed in the upstream definitions; the statement spells out the list length in terms of the reduction width $R$ without naming a Lean identifier.
